args.title: Support non-Western currency symbols in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount to strip generic currency symbols/characters from the amount string instead of hardcoding specific currency symbols like €$£¥.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

parseAmount hardcodes specific currency symbols (EUR, USD, GBP, JPY) to strip, causing amounts with other currency signs like the rupee (₹) or Swiss franc (CHF) prefixes to be rejected as non-numbers.
